source: ScanTwin failure catalogue and QC thresholds.xlsx

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Distances and volumes measured too large or small everywhere
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Max deviation of phantom lengths from true (190 mm)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Gradient calibration by service engineer; re-run phantom
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Gradient strength miscalibrated, so position encoding is scaled wrongly
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Scanner after service or hardware change

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Partial-volume mixing changes contrast and small-structure volumes
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Measured slice thickness minus nominal (5 mm)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: RF pulse / gradient calibration; re-run phantom
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Slice-select pulse profile or gradient amplitude off

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Slices land off target; the same anatomy is not compared between sessions
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Recalibrate table position / gradients; check positioning lasers
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Table position or gradient offset drift

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Same tissue looks brighter in one part of the image; segmentation and intensity features biased
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: < 87.5 (≤ 1.5 T); 3 T has a lower ACR limit (verify)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check coil, RF calibration; apply bias-field correction
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Uneven B1 transmit or coil sensitivity
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Large body or head, high field

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Faint copies of anatomy overlap the region and add false signal
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Service check (gradient timing, RF stability); repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Signal instability between phase-encode lines

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Small or subtle structures can be missed
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: < 9 (1.5 T); 3 T has a higher ACR limit (verify)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check coil and SNR; service
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Low SNR or poor contrast performance of the system

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Fine detail blurred; edges and small volumes inaccurate
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check gradients and reconstruction; service
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Point-spread function wider than specified

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Peaks shift and broaden in spectra; images shift in EPI
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Frequency correction per average; let system settle after heavy gradient use
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Magnet or passive-shim temperature changes, often after gradient-heavy scans

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: SNR drops in part of the image; uneven signal
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Swap or repair coil; repeat with working coil
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: One receive channel broken or disconnected

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Zipper lines or herringbone patterns in images; spikes in spectra
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: Zipper or spike over region of interest
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Close RF door, remove electronics; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: External RF noise or static discharge leaks into receiver

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Nothing guarantees the scanner was working on that day
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Run daily phantom QC before patient scans

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Broader lines; peaks overlap (Cho/Cr); ratios biased and noisier
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Re-shim (higher-order shim), smaller voxel away from air/bone; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Field not uniform across voxel, so spins resonate at slightly different frequencies
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Voxel near sinuses or skull, metal implants

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Noisy spectrum; fit uncertainty grows; small changes invisible
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: More averages, larger voxel, check coil
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Too few averages, small voxel or poor coil coupling
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Small voxel requested, restless subject (short scan)

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Concentration or ratio too uncertain to compare
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB) of the metabolite
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Improve SNR and linewidth; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Noise and peak overlap limit how well the fit can pin the peak

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Huge residual water distorts the baseline; nearby peaks biased
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Residual water peak / NAA peak height
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Recalibrate water-suppression pulses; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Water-suppression pulses mistuned in flip angle or frequency

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Lipid signal from the scalp overlaps lactate and the baseline
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Move voxel away from skull, add outer-volume suppression
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Signal from outside the voxel leaks in through imperfect localisation

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Artificial peaks or ripples mistaken for metabolites
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Out-of-phase or broad artefact signals present
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Adjust crusher gradients and phase cycling; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Signal from outside the voxel refocused by imperfect crushing

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Asymmetric peaks; fit model wrong; ratios biased
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Eddy-current correction using water reference
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Fast gradient switching induces currents that distort phase over time

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Each metabolite comes from a slightly different cube, so ratios mix tissues
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Higher-bandwidth pulses or sLASER sequence
failure_catalogue.Threshold source: Dossier §5.5 (2.4 mm/axis = 12% for PRESS at 3 T); Team proposal (limits)
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Slice-selective pulses select position by frequency, which differs per metabolite
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: PRESS at high field, large voxel

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Different tissue mix measured; looks like chemical change
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Voxel centre distance from baseline position
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Reposition with saved baseline localiser / auto-align
failure_catalogue.Threshold source: Dossier §5.5 (2 mm ≈ 10% tissue exchanged); Team proposal (limits)
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Head positioned differently or voxel prescribed by hand

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: More CSF in voxel lowers all metabolites without any chemical change
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Change in CSF fraction of the voxel
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Segment voxel and apply tissue correction
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Voxel contains different proportions of grey matter, white matter and CSF

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Ratio change could come from the denominator, not the metabolite
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: Ratio and absolute values disagree in direction
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Acquire unsuppressed water reference
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Creatine itself can change, so X/Cr is not a pure measure of X

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Corrupted averages; broader lines; wrong tissue
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Padding, shorter scan, prospective motion correction
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Head moves, shifting the voxel and the field

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Systematic bias in every metabolite
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Basis set TE and field match the acquisition
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Use basis set simulated for this TE, field and sequence
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Fit uses reference spectra simulated for a different protocol

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Signal from neighbouring voxels, especially scalp lipid, leaks into brain voxels
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Lipid suppression, k-space filtering, smaller FOV
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Limited k-space sampling spreads each voxel's signal

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Blurring and ringing; volumes and edges unreliable
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Motion rating (1 none – 4 severe) or image sharpness score
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Padding, instructions, shorter or motion-corrected sequence; repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Head moves during k-space filling

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Grey/white boundary unclear; segmentation errors
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check coil, more averages
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Weak signal relative to noise

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Same tissue brighter in one area; segmentation and volumes biased
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Coefficient of variation of white-matter intensity
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Apply bias-field correction; check coil
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Uneven transmit field or receive coil sensitivity

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Signal voids and distortion near metal or air
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Artefact overlap with region of interest
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Remove metal if possible; use less sensitive sequence
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Different magnetic properties of metal or air distort the field

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Anatomy from outside the field of view folds onto the image
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Enlarge field of view or use oversampling
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Field of view smaller than the object

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Ripples at sharp edges mimic thin structures
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Higher resolution or filtering
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Finite k-space sampling cuts off high frequencies

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Region outline lands wrongly; fake volume change
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Re-register; check with landmarks; same software version
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Imperfect alignment of the two scans
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Head position very different between sessions

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Error bar far too small, so a change looks significant when it isn't
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Recompute uncertainty from registration quality
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Pipeline did not propagate boundary error into volume uncertainty

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Volumes shift because the method changed
failure_catalogue.WARN if: Different version, re-run on both sessions
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Re-run both sessions with one version
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Different algorithms draw boundaries differently

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Contrast and ratios not comparable between sessions
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Sequence family, TE, TR, TI, flip angle, field match baseline
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Use the baseline protocol
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Signal weighting depends on timing parameters

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Geometry and ADC biased far from scanner centre
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Distortion correction applied; distance from isocentre
failure_catalogue.WARN if: Not applied, region < 100 mm from centre
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: Not applied, region ≥ 100 mm from centre
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Turn on vendor distortion correction; centre region
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Gradient fields not perfectly linear away from centre

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Ghost copies of vessels or CSF along the phase direction
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Ghost overlap with region of interest
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Flow compensation, swap phase direction, saturation bands
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Moving blood or CSF acquires different phase

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Image stretched or compressed near air and bone; misaligned with anatomy
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Reverse phase-encode scan and distortion correction
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Field inhomogeneity shifts EPI signal along the phase direction

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Directions misaligned; ADC and FA biased
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Eddy-current correction; twice-refocused sequence
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Strong diffusion gradients induce currents

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: ADC changes with temperature, not tissue
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Phantom ADC deviation from known value (ice water at 0 °C: 1.1×10⁻³ mm²/s)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Temperature-controlled phantom; record temperature
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Water diffusion speeds up with temperature

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: ADC biased off-centre
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Apply b-value correction map
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Actual gradient strength differs from nominal off-centre

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: ADC overestimated or underestimated in low-signal tissue
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: More averages, lower maximum b
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Magnitude images have a noise floor that biases weak signals

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Directions misaligned; FA and ADC unreliable
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Padding, motion correction, repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Head moves during the long diffusion series

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: False activation and connectivity patterns
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Padding, instructions, scrub volumes, repeat
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Movement changes the signal more than brain activity does
failure_catalogue.Context that raises the risk: Children, older adults, patients in discomfort

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Real activity hidden in noise
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Larger voxels, check coil, check for spikes
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Thermal and physiological noise too large

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Slow trends look like activity
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Detrend; let scanner settle; check for heating
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Scanner heating and field drift

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: T1 values biased across the image
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Acquire B1 map and correct
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Actual flip angle differs from the one requested

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Systematic offset in T1 or T2
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check fitting model and inversion pulse; phantom calibration
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Fitting model does not match real signal behaviour

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Images look different only because of the field strength
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Feature defined as comparable across fields and harmonised
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Use field-robust features (e.g. geometry); harmonise
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Relaxation, contrast and SNR all change with field

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Reconstruction can copy the old scan and hide or invent change
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Reconstruction used a previous scan as prior
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: Prior-enhanced image used as evidence of change
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Keep enhanced images apart from change evidence
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: AI or prior-based reconstruction fills in from the earlier scan

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Weak signals; kinetic rate unreliable
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check polariser and transfer time
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Polarisation decays with T1 before and during the scan

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Conversion rate (kPL) biased
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Record injection and arrival times
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Delivery delay mixes with metabolic conversion

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Extra apparent signal decay biases kPL
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Calibrate flip angle on a ¹³C phantom
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Each RF pulse consumes non-renewable magnetisation

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Evidence cannot be interpreted or traced
failure_catalogue.WARN if: Optional field missing (kept as explicit null + reason)
failure_catalogue.FAIL if: Required field missing or wrong type
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Fix the export pipeline; never fill values silently

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Physically impossible number (e.g. negative concentration)
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Check fit and processing; route to owning track

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Numbers compared in different units
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Unit present and matches data dictionary
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Add units at export

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Cannot check comparability or ppm scale
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Nominal field and spectrometer frequency (ν0) both present
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Store both (e.g. 3.0 T nominal, 123.25 MHz = 2.895 T actual)

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Twin cannot place the scan on its timeline
failure_catalogue.QC metric: Session date and relative time consistent across files
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Fix sessions.tsv and DICOM dates

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: Privacy breach; dataset cannot be shared
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Strip and pseudonymise metadata

failure_catalogue.Effect on the result: A difference is reported as change when it is within noise
failure_catalogue.Fix for the next scan: Repeat at PASS quality before claiming change
failure_catalogue.What physically happens: Two uncertain measurements always differ a little

decision_rules.Rule: Identify the scan type and select every catalogue row whose Scan type matches, plus all rows marked 'All' and 'All (data)'
decision_rules.Notes: Scan type comes from the DICOM / BIDS metadata, never guessed

decision_rules.Rule: Read the context factors (sheet 'Context factors') and note which failure IDs they raise
decision_rules.Notes: Context only changes warnings and fixes, never the PASS / WARN / FAIL limits

decision_rules.Rule: Compute each gate's QC metric and compare with its PASS / WARN / FAIL limits
decision_rules.Notes: A metric that cannot be computed is kept as explicit null + reason, never imputed
Twin state does not change. Show the failing gate, its value and its fix

decision_rules.Rule: No FAIL, at least one WARN
decision_rules.Notes: Evidence variance doubled for the gain (R = 2·u²); gate still tested with u²; reasons shown
Normal Kalman update with R = u²
|z| < 1.96: no change claimed. Declare one primary variable first, or divide 0.05 by the number of variables tested
Asks whether the new value is surprising for the twin, not only for the noise

decision_rules.Rule: Rank fixes from all WARN / FAIL gates by uncertainty removed per scanner minute
decision_rules.Notes: A fix that tells two explanations apart (e.g. re-shim vs real change) wins even with small variance gain

scan_types.What it measures: Brain chemistry in one small cube
Brain chemistry on a grid of voxels
Scanner performance on a test object
Anatomy at a lower field, at point of care
Metabolic conversion over about a minute

context_factors.Context factor: Likely to move (child, older adult, claustrophobia, pain, tremor)
context_factors.How the twin uses it: Expect motion WARNs; suggest shorter or motion-corrected sequences and padding first

context_factors.Context factor: Metal implants, dental work, surgical clips
context_factors.How the twin uses it: Expect broader lines and distortion; suggest voxel placement away from metal, less sensitive sequences

context_factors.Context factor: Voxel or region near sinuses, skull or air
context_factors.How the twin uses it: Expect shim and lipid problems; suggest moving the voxel or extra suppression
Require tissue correction of metabolites; expect larger partial-volume effects
context_factors.Never used for: Interpreting the person's values as normal or abnormal

context_factors.How the twin uses it: Expect larger volume uncertainty from the same registration error (3·σb/r)
Expect bias field and wrap-around; suggest larger FOV, B1 correction

context_factors.Context factor: Different scanner, site or field from baseline
context_factors.How the twin uses it: Force protocol and harmonisation checks before any comparison
Expect frequency drift; suggest frequency correction or a pause

sources.What it covers: Challenge dossier v1.5: acceptance thresholds §5.8, geometry §5.5, field §4.2, change test §3.10
ACR MRI accreditation phantom action criteria: geometry ±2 mm, slice thickness 5 ± 0.7 mm, slice position < 5 mm, PIU > 87.5%, ghosting ≤ 0.025, low-contrast > 9 spokes
Wilson et al. 2019: linewidth < 0.1 ppm needed for accurate analysis
Framewise-displacement limits of about 0.2–0.5 mm are widely used; not verified for this sheet
Teaching values set by our team where no standard exists. Replace with test-retest or literature values before any real use
